Explosives found near German power plant, investigation underway

Explosive devices were discovered near a power plant in Germany, prompting an investigation into a potential attack on the power grid. Police are examining the incident, which involved improvised explosive devices found in proximity to the facility. The exact nature of the devices and their intended target are currently under investigation.
